pipeline_scope: Three matched writes and one reconstruction, including journal constructor/close; common source loading and imports excluded.
scope: Paired persistence replay only; no engine execution, held-out loading or capability claim.

main_failure_clusters: Repeated whole-history serialization consumes CPU between verified search operations.
cycle_report.deep_bottleneck_abstraction: Persistence cost grows with all prior trials despite completed searches/generations being immutable.
cycle_report.why_previous_improvement_attempts_were_i: The previous streaming atomic serializer avoided a full copy but still walked and wrote every prior candidate on every checkpoint.
cycle_report.proposed_intervention: Identity-cached immutable search/generation journal plus an atomic live-root manifest.
cycle_report.expected_mechanism_of_improvement: Serialize completed immutable evidence once and reference it thereafter while updating mutable proof/counter/state fields.
cycle_report.verification_plan: Exact original JSON values/order, real controller callback roundtrips, committed-prefix/truncation recovery, and pre/post-publication fault injection.
regression_risks: Requires immutable completed-search and completed-generation contract and single writer.
First journal write and journal reconstruction can cost more.
Strong identity references retain archived objects during the run.
cycle_report.keep_revert_revise_decision: Keep persistence implementation after independent transaction review; no capability or RSI admission.
cycle_report.updated_rule_for_future_improvement_cycl: Archive immutable verified evidence once; atomically publish references only after durable append, and separately measure persistence and reconstruction CPU.
